title: Alishan vs Taroko Gorge: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Alishan for mystical mountain atmosphere and sunrises; Taroko for dramatic geology and hiking. Both are must-dos in Taiwan.

categories.name: Main Experience
categories.summary: Alishan offers mystical sea of clouds and ancient forests. Taroko delivers dramatic marble canyon geology. Both are world-class.

categories.name: Scenic Highlights
categories.summary: Alishan needs clear sunrise weather; Taroko delivers in almost any conditions.

categories.name: Hiking
categories.summary: Taroko offers everything from easy riverside walks to world-class multi-day treks. Alishan trails are gentle and limited.

categories.name: Getting There
categories.summary: Taroko is a direct 2-hour train from Taipei. Alishan requires HSR + 2.5hr winding bus ride.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Taroko is 30-40% cheaper: free entry, affordable Hualien accommodation, shorter journey.

categories.name: Best Time to Visit
categories.summary: Taroko has 8 months of good weather. Alishan peaks during narrow cherry blossom and autumn windows.

categories.name: Crowds & Safety
categories.summary: Both manageable on weekdays. Alishan challenge is logistics; Taroko challenge is rockfall awareness.

categories.name: Day Trip Flexibility
categories.summary: Taroko works as a day trip from Hualien. Alishan requires overnight for the sunrise.

categories.name: Why Not Both
categories.summary: With 7+ days in Taiwan, most travelers do both. They complement each other perfectly.

categories.name: Accommodation
categories.summary: Hualien has full range from hostels to resorts. Alishan mountain lodges are limited and overpriced.

faq.question: Should I visit Alishan or Taroko Gorge if I only have time for one?
faq.answer: Reddit slightly favors Taroko for first-timers. The marble canyon is unlike anything in Asia and requires less planning. During cherry blossom season (March-April), Alishan is equally compelling.

faq.question: How far apart are Alishan and Taroko Gorge?
faq.answer: On opposite sides of the Central Mountain Range. 4-5 hours by road, 3-4 hours by train via Chiayi to Hualien.

faq.question: Can you visit both in one trip?
faq.answer: Yes, most 7+ day Taiwan itineraries include both. Common route: Taipei to Hualien/Taroko, then train to Chiayi/Alishan.

faq.question: Is Taroko Gorge still open after the 2024 earthquake?
faq.answer: Gradually reopening but several trails (including Tunnel of Nine Turns) remain closed as of early 2026. Check official website.

faq.question: What is the best time to visit Alishan?
faq.answer: March-April for cherry blossoms, October-November for clear sunrise views.

faq.question: How do I get to Alishan from Taipei?
faq.answer: HSR to Chiayi (1.5hr, NT$1,080), then tourist shuttle bus (2.5hr, NT$278). Total about 4 hours.

faq.question: How do I get to Taroko from Taipei?
faq.answer: Tze-Chiang Express to Hualien (2hr, NT$440), then tourist shuttle bus or rent a scooter. Total about 2.5 hours.

faq.question: Which is more budget-friendly?
faq.answer: Taroko. Free park entry, cheaper Hualien accommodation, shorter journey. A 2-day trip costs NT$3,500-7,000 vs NT$6,000-10,000 for Alishan.
